title: Russian — ALA-LC without diacritics (ASCII)
authority: Library of Congress / American Library Association (2012 table, diacritics omitted)
description: ALA-LC romanization with diacritics and ligature ties removed (Ë→E, Ĭ→I, Ė→E, t͡s→ts, i͡u→iu, i͡a→ia), the usual form in bibliographies and ASCII-only systems; Ъ→" and Ь→'.
notes: Not a separate official table: it is ALA-LC with the diacritics and ties dropped, as commonly practised (iuliia 'ala_lc_alt'). Some users also drop the " and ' signs.
samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
Iuliia, s"esh' eshche etikh miagkikh frantsuzskikh bulok iz Ioshkar-Oly, da vypei altaiskogo chaiu
